sentence: This project builds a program that combines fabrication technology with automation technology, including robotics and welding robots.
This project studies how fishes detect light with their skin and how this helps them change color.
This project tries to predict which cybersecurity tasks will be augmented by AI, replaced by AI, or remain human-driven.
This project builds a research laboratory with tanks and aquaria and dry space for microscope work and DNA extraction.
This project tries to make molecular wires with radicals that carry charge over long distances.
This project runs chemistry projects such as nanomaterial synthesis, the degradation of herbicides and mass spectrometry instrumentation.
This project builds a method that uses deep neural networks to estimate and predict dynamic systems.
This project studies random growth models in different geometric settings and how the geometry and boundary shape their behavior.
This project tries to measure a mathematical challenge to quantum computing, called near-integrability.
This project builds machine learning methods that work on stratified matrix manifolds, using ideas from topology and geometry.
This project measures chemicals from a firefighting foam spill in soil and water samples to learn how they move over time.
This project studies redox reactions and tries to detect single bacteria using electrochemiluminescence in droplets.
This project studies how seasonal changes trigger changes in butterfly wing color and whether those changes affect mating success.
This project builds a platform where forest researchers share forest inventory data under the sharing policies set by data contributors.
This project builds a framework for quickly qualifying 3D printed metal parts by testing their fatigue performance.
This project builds a testbed and uses AI to detect and predict cyber-attacks on cloud-based cyber-physical systems.
This project uses seismic data to make images of the subseafloor fluid drainage network at a subduction zone.
